nodes.title: Start here
widgets_values:
{"version": 1, "tone": "icon", "look": "card", "step": 1, "icon": "flag", "text": "### Pick and refine

Four quick drafts, each from its own roll of the lists. The run **pauses** so you can pick the keepers (and fix a prompt or paint a mask), then refines only those. The lists come with this workflow.

| Key | Step |
|---|---|
| `Alt+1` | Four different prompts |
| `Alt+2` | Quick drafts |
| `Alt+3` | Pick the keepers |
| `Alt+4` | Refine only the picks |
| `Alt+5` | The picks, refined |

:pi-bookmark: Jump with the keys or the **Bookmarks** dock (top bar).

---

**Questions, ideas, packs to share:**

[Discord](https://discord.gg/BFYR9WQdVR){button pi-discord #5865f2} [Community packs](https://wp.dumiflex.dev){button pi-globe #22c55e} [Wiki](https://github.com/DumiFlex/ComfyUI-Wildcard-Pipeline/wiki){button pi-github #8b949e} [About these examples](docs:howto-examples){button pi-th-large}", "color": "", "bookmark": null}
